title: 空间站的菜园与树懒的花园
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol21/Vol21_晚读讲义_空间站的菜园与树懒的花园_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol21_晚读讲义_空间站的菜园与树懒的花园_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! This is our twenty-first show together! Today we visit a garden floating high above Earth, and an animal that wears a garden on its back. One grows dinner in space. One grows a forest in its fur. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！这是我们在一起的第二十一期节目啦！今天我们要去参观一座漂浮在地球高空之上的花园，还要认识一只把花园穿在背上的动物。一个在太空里种晚餐，一个在毛里种森林。出发吧！

blocks.en: High above Earth, inside the International Space Station, astronauts decided to grow salad. But space has no soil, and no up or down. So NASA built a small garden box called Veggie.
blocks.title: 空间站的菜园
blocks.cn: 在地球的高空之上，在国际空间站里面，宇航员们决定种沙拉。可太空里没有土壤，也分不清上下左右。于是，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）造了一个名叫 Veggie 的小菜园箱子。

blocks.en: The seeds slept in little bags called plant pillows, under lamps of red and blue light. Water moved along small wicks, because in space water does not fall — it floats. Light, water and air are the primary needs of every plant, in space or on Earth.
blocks.title: 空间站的菜园
blocks.cn: 种子睡在名叫“植物枕头”的小袋子里，头顶是红色和蓝色的灯光。水沿着细细的灯芯流动，因为在太空里水不会往下掉——它会飘起来。光、水和空气，是每一株植物最首要的需求，不管在太空还是在地球上都一样。

blocks.en: After about a month, the crew picked red romaine lettuce, a variety called "Outredgeous." They cleaned each leaf with a wipe, then tasted it. "It tastes like arugula," one astronaut said, to everyone's delight. Cheers erupted around the table.
blocks.title: 空间站的菜园
blocks.cn: 大约一个月之后，乘组摘下了红叶生菜，一个名叫“Outredgeous”的品种。他们把每一片叶子擦干净，然后尝了一口。“吃起来像芝麻菜，”一位宇航员说，大家都欣喜不已。餐桌周围爆发出一阵欢呼。

blocks.en: It takes courage to taste food grown where no food has ever grown. Half the leaves were saved and frozen for study back on Earth. The rest was eaten with olive oil and vinegar — the first space salad, grown high above the dinner table.
blocks.title: 空间站的菜园
blocks.cn: 品尝从来没有人种过的地方长出来的食物，是需要勇气的。一半的叶子被留下来、冷冻好，带回地球做研究。剩下的拌上橄榄油和醋吃掉了——这是第一份太空沙拉，种在离餐桌很远很远的高空。

blocks.en: Now meet the three-toed sloth, the slowest mammal in the world. It sleeps, eats leaves and barely moves — but look at its shaggy fur.
blocks.title: 树懒毛里的小花园
blocks.cn: 现在来认识一下三趾树懒，它是世界上最慢的哺乳动物。它睡觉、吃树叶，几乎一动不动——可是请仔细看看它那身蓬松的毛。

blocks.en: Each hair has tiny grooves that hold rainwater. In that wet fur, green algae grows, turning the sloth's coat into a green garment. The green is perfect camouflage: among the leaves, the sloth almost disappears.
blocks.title: 树懒毛里的小花园
blocks.cn: 每一根毛上都有细细的沟槽，能留住雨水。在这身潮湿的毛里，绿藻生长起来，把树懒的外衣变成了一件绿外套。这绿色是完美的伪装：在树叶之间，树懒几乎就消失不见了。

blocks.en: But the garden has more tenants: tiny sloth moths live in the fur. Once a week, the sloth climbs slowly down to the forest floor — a long and risky trip — and the moths lay their eggs in its droppings. When the young moths grow up, they fly back into the fur. When old moths die there, their bodies break down and feed the algae, like fertilizer.
blocks.title: 树懒毛里的小花园
blocks.cn: 可是这座花园里还有更多的住客：小小的树懒蛾就住在毛里。每星期一次，树懒慢吞吞地爬下树，来到森林地面——这是一段漫长而冒险的旅程——蛾子们趁机把卵产在它的粪便里。等小蛾子长大了，它们又飞回毛里。老蛾子死在毛里之后，身体分解开来，给绿藻施肥，就像肥料一样。

blocks.en: It is no coincidence that sloths with more moths grow more algae. And here is the astonishing part: scientists think the sloth sometimes licks its own fur and eats the algae for extra food. In the dry season, when rain is rare, the green fades a little — but the garden waits for the next rain. A sloth is not just one animal — it is a whole small world.
blocks.title: 树懒毛里的小花园
blocks.cn: 身上蛾子越多的树懒，绿藻就长得越多，这可不是巧合。还有更令人惊讶的部分：科学家认为，树懒有时候会舔自己的毛、吃掉绿藻，给自己加餐。在旱季、雨水稀少的时候，绿色会稍微褪去一点——但这座花园会等着下一场雨。一只树懒可不只是一只动物——它就是一个小小的世界。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "head in the clouds." Your head is where you think, and clouds are high in the sky, far away. So if your head is in the clouds, your thoughts are far away — you are daydreaming, not paying attention. Listen to this: During science class, Mia had her head in the clouds, dreaming about growing lettuce in space. The teacher asked, "Mia, what do plants need?" Mia blinked and said, "Light, water, and... a rocket?" The whole class laughed. Mia's head had been in the clouds — but her dream was a good one!
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“head in the clouds”（脑袋在云里）。你的脑袋是用来思考的地方，而云朵高高地飘在天上、离得很远。所以，如果你的脑袋在云里，你的思绪就飘远了——你就是在发白日梦、没有专心听讲。听这个小故事：科学课上，Mia 的脑袋在云里，正梦想着在太空种生菜呢。老师问：“Mia，植物需要什么？”Mia 眨了眨眼，说：“光、水，还有……一枚火箭？”全班都笑了。Mia 的脑袋刚才确实在云里——不过她的梦想可不坏！

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. Astronauts grew salad in space, and a sloth carries a garden in its fur. Two questions for you. First: if you could grow one food in space, what would it be, and why? Second: the sloth's fur garden helps it hide and find food. If you could wear a garden, what would you grow in it? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。宇航员在太空种出了沙拉，树懒在毛里随身带着一座花园。轮到回答两个问题。第一：如果你能在太空种一种食物，你会种什么，为什么？第二：树懒毛里的小花园既能帮它藏身、又能帮它找食物。如果你能穿上一座花园，你会在里面种什么？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Remember: keep your feet on the ground, but let your dreams reach the stars. Stay curious, and keep exploring. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里，小小探险家们。记住：脚要踏踏实实地踩在地上，但梦想可以够到星星。保持好奇心，继续探索吧。明天早上见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
How did the astronauts water their space plants?
A. They used rain
B. They sprayed the plants with hoses
C. Water moved along small wicks
D. They poured water from bottles

What did the first space salad taste like?
A. Like spinach
B. Like arugula
C. Like carrots
D. Like tomatoes

Why does the sloth's fur look green?
A. Algae grows in its wet fur
B. It paints its fur green
C. It eats green leaves all day
D. The sun turns its fur green

What does "head in the clouds" mean?
A. Sleeping on a cloud
B. Flying in an airplane
C. Climbing a tall mountain
D. Daydreaming, not paying attention

children.text: In that wet fur, green algae
，被提前到了句首：它交代整件事发生的地点——"在那身潮湿的毛里"。英语里地点状语放句首很常见，读的时候先抓住"在哪里"，再看"发生了什么"。
虽然以 -ae 结尾、看起来像复数，但在这里作不可数名词看待，所以动词用单数
turning the sloth's coat into a green garment
现在分词短语作结果状语
：它表示主句动作带来的结果——绿藻一长，结果就是树懒的外衣"变成了"绿外套。分词短语的逻辑主语和主句主语一致（都是 green algae），所以可以直接挂在句尾。
是固定搭配，意思是"把……变成……"：
，A 是原来的东西，B 是变成之后的样子。这里 A = the sloth's coat（树懒的外衣），B = a green garment（一件绿外套）。
地点（潮湿的毛里）→ 生长（绿藻长起来）→ 结果（外衣变成绿外套）
。一句话讲完树懒"穿上绿外套"的全过程。
"Water moved along small wicks, because in space water does not fall — it floats."
"In that wet fur, green algae grows, turning the sloth's coat into a green garment."

words.clue: A piece of clothing that covers the body, like a coat. Example: The algae turns the sloth's coat into a green ___.
Tiny green living things that grow in wet places. Example: Green ___ grows in the sloth's wet fur.
A green leafy plant often eaten in salads. Example: The crew picked red romaine ___, a variety called Outredgeous.
A place where plants grow. Example: The sloth carries a ___ in its fur.
The name of a small box where astronauts grow plants in space. Example: NASA built a small garden box called ___.
The brave feeling that helps you face something hard or new. Example: It takes ___ to taste food grown where no food has ever grown.
High, soft white shapes in the sky, used in a saying about daydreaming. Example: If your head is in the ___, your thoughts are far away.
A small flying insect with soft wings, like a butterfly that flies at night. Example: Tiny sloth ___s live in the fur.
A very slow animal that sleeps in trees and moves very little. Example: The slowest mammal in the world is the three-toed ___.
Colours or shapes that help an animal hide by looking like what is around it. Example: The green is perfect ___: among the leaves, the sloth almost disappears.
